items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: Louis Armstrong was playing in Carroll Dickerson's band... I don't know where, didn't even know him.

ctx.x: Was he sort of promoted as the rival to Louis Armstrong?

Yeah, well, I was going to tell you. This happened when Louis was in the Savoy Ballroom, and like, on a Sunday afternoon, this side the bandstand was Clarence Black's band, and over here was Carroll Dickerson. Louis Armstrong was playing in Carroll Dickerson's band, Tubbie Hall and all of them were over here in Clarence Black's band. And this guy came in -- I don't know where, didn't even know him. Boy, and he started blowing that horn, boy, and sweat come over Pop's -- and he was -- and that was one of the…

mean, it was a real rivalry, yeah. Right, because he sat in Clarence Black's band, Jabbo did, and then Louis, who naturally, you know -- and boy, that was really something. And he was playing then, Jabbo was.
